title: The Trade Desk Appoints Vinny Rinaldi as Vice President of Client Strategy & Growth
summary: Industry veteran brings decades of marketing, data and digital transformation experience to help brands maximize business outcomes in the AI era The Trade Desk, a leading advertising technology company, today announced that Vinny Rinaldi has joined the company as Vice President of Client Strategy Growth. In this role, Rinaldi will partner closely with marketers to help them unlock greater value from data-driven advertising, navigate the rapidly evolving media landscape and accelerate business growth through the premium open internet. Rinaldi will report to Chief Operating Officer, Vivek Kundra. Rinaldi joins The Trade Desk with more than two decades of experience leading marketing transformation initiatives for some of the world's most recognizable brands. Most recently, Vinny served as Vice President of Consumer Connections at The Hershey Company.
